tree-sitter-java-orchard 0.5.15 wasm rebuilt from grammar.js with Java currency-symbol identifiers.

grammar.js identifier:
  /[\p{XID_Start}\p{Sc}_$][\p{XID_Continue}\p{Sc}_$]*/

JLS IdentifierChars includes Sc (euro, pound, yen). Upstream XID_Start does not.
Drop this vendor copy after orchard ships the regex.
